mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0 percentage points, it signals a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates a contraction in consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During early expansion cycles, strong industrial production growth improves corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) during periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly and the economy is in an early expansion cycle.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI growth exceeds 3.0 percentage points, it signals inflationary pressure that triggers Fed tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment and decline in employment growth signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS growth declines.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in retail sales, as measured by RSAFS, indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 650,000 units, it indicates a housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 650.0.
